name: Shared lint packages + @shoptet/datalayer knowledge pack
description:
Ship @shoptet/stylelint-config and @shoptet/eslint-config: Layer-1 selector-risk rules (selector-max-combinators/type/universal/specificity, selector-no-qualifying-type, a custom postcss-selector-parser rule for `*` / `* >` and positional patterns) plus the load-order rule (no-load-order-globals).

Integrate @shoptet/datalayer (already on npm): scaffold the ambient shoptet-env.d.ts typing window.dataLayer, wire tsc --noEmit typecheck, and the data-driven ESLint rule reading the published JSON Schema (flags reads of fields absent from the schema, unguarded optional-branch access, wrong-pageType reads).

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §8.
